title: Diameter of Binary Tree

statement.hi:
Binary tree ka `root` diya hai. Tree ka **diameter** return karo: kisi bhi do nodes ke beech ke sabse lambe path ki length.

Length = path me **edges** ki sankhya. Ye path root se guzre, ye zaroori nahi.
statement.en:
Given the `root` of a binary tree, return the **diameter** of the tree: the length of the longest path between any two nodes.

Length = the number of **edges** on the path. The path may or may not pass through the root.

hi: Har node pe "best path jo is node se mudta hai" = left height + right height.
Ek DFS me height return karo aur saath me global answer update karte raho.
en: At each node, the best path that turns there = left height + right height.
Return the height from one DFS and update a global answer along the way.

approach.hi:
Post-order DFS jo height return kare. Har node pe `left + right` (dono subtrees ki heights) us node se mudne wale path ki edges hain — global `best` me max rakho.
Har node ek baar: O(n) time, O(h) stack.
approach.en:
Post-order DFS that returns the height. At each node, `left + right` (the two subtree heights) is the edge count of the path turning there — keep the max in a global `best`.
Each node once: O(n) time, O(h) stack.
